name: iLovePDF
label: iLovePDF REST API
description: iLovePDF REST start/{tool} only. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://developer.ilovepdf.com/docs/api-reference. Each operation calls GET /start/{tool} and returns a task id. Upload, process and download are separate signed calls the engine cannot chain. Auth: public_key (JWT is minted by iLovePDF start). Never log public_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: merge, split, compress, pdfjpg, imagepdf, unlock, protect, rotate, repair, watermark.

schema.label: Ranges
schema.description: Page ranges for split when split_mode=ranges. Example: 1-3,5.

schema.label: Password
schema.description: Password for protect (required) or unlock (encrypted file password).

schema.label: Rotate
schema.description: Per-file rotation for rotate op (degrees in files[]). Example: 90.

schema.label: Text
schema.description: Watermark text when mode=text. Required for text watermarks.

schema.label: Files
schema.description: Files array for merge/process (multiple server_filenames). Example: [{"server_filename":"..."}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Public Key
configurationParameters.description: Bearer JWT minted outside StudioQuack (POST /v1/auth with the project public key, or a self-signed JWT). Not the raw public key. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Ranges
configurationParameters.description: Page ranges for split when split_mode=ranges. Example: 1-3,5.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: Password for protect (required) or unlock (encrypted file password).

configurationParameters.label: Rotate
configurationParameters.description: Per-file rotation for rotate op (degrees in files[]). Example: 90.

configurationParameters.label: Text
configurationParameters.description: Watermark text when mode=text. Required for text watermarks.

configurationParameters.label: Files
configurationParameters.description: Files array for merge/process (multiple server_filenames). Example: [{"server_filename":"..."}].
